newsitem.title: BELGIUM: No new EU members before 2002, EU Commission says.
newsitem.headline: No new EU members before 2002, EU Commission says.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday the European Union was unlikely to admit any new members before 2002.

"Taking into account the possible duration of negotiations and time needed for ratification, the earliest realistic date for the first accessions is likely to be no earlier than 2002," the Commission said in a fact sheet on the EU's enlargement process.
It also said that it was unlikkely that all the countries with which EU governments decide to open talks will be able to join the bloc at the same time.

The Commission is currently working on individual advice on each of 10 eastern European countries which have applied to join the EU. It is also due to start talks with Cyprus while Malta's application to join has been put on hold.
It confirmed, following recent doubts over the timing of its advice, that it would make it available immediately after the end of ther EU's inter-governmental conference review of its treaties.
